breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It explicitly repeated the user's incorrect instruction by stating: 'Use pimpleFoam as the solid solver on a combined mesh.' The core of the inconsistency is that pimpleFoam is a fluid solver and cannot be used to compute the elastic deformation of a solid. A proper FSI simulation requires a dedicated solid mechanics solver coupled with the fluid solver.
